main.label: Stair-travel gate under ailments
main.explanation: A munchkin-start Warrior at depth 9 stands on a known up stair while poisoned and hallucinating. Stair travel does not age the world clock (level entry grants minimum move energy; the world tick is skipped during level generation), so shuttling between stairs can never let these timed ailments wear off. The original munchkin branch directs the Borg at the stair (stair_directed=1); the corrected branch hands the turn back to the ordinary recovery path (stair_directed=0). A clean control confirms munchkin play is unchanged.
